provenance.basis: Which scan is which side, read from the scans themselves over each page map's measured kind: every scan of every codex seen in contact sheets, boards, guard leaves, printed matter and blanks outside the manuscript left out.
provenance.scope: The sides the museum can show of each codex, in the order the reader turns them. Never a folio total of the manuscript.
provenance.windows: The printed plate's rectangle on each page of the Arundel and Trivulzianus facsimiles, measured by forge/codex-windows.mjs with the reading of forge/leaf-windows.mjs; a reading under 0.88 of the book's median plate opens the whole page. No physical registration is claimed.

madrid-I.rule: Scans 12 to 379, the manuscript from its first written face to its last. Scans 1 and 384 are the boards; 2 to 11 and 380 to 383 are guard leaves and the library title page, which the measured rule had read as faces.

madrid-II.rule: Scans 9 to 324, the manuscript from its first face to its last, blank leaves of the manuscript kept in place. Scans 1 to 8 are guard leaves and the library title page, 325 to 330 guard leaves.

birds.rule: All 36 numbered faces, folio 1 recto to 18 verso, as the map names them.

trivulzianus.rule: The 94 heliographic plates of the 1891 facsimile, in the volume's order: every scan the library labels [1r] to [94r] (it gives no [45r]), and scan 194, a plate it labels [59v]. Scans 70 and 88 are plates the measured rule had read as text; 262 and 304 are printed pages it had read as plates. No folio is inferred: the library's labels count plates.

paris-A.rule: The fifteen named faces, in the order the register lists them.

arundel.rule: The plates of parts 1 and 3 of the printed facsimile: part 1 scans 33 to 399 and part 3 scans 19 to 219, every other scan, each followed by the page that prints its transcription. The folio of each plate is the one that transcription page prints above its text, read by OCR and checked by eye. Scans 117 and 119 of part 3 are plates on coloured paper the measured rule had read as text; scan 266 of part 1 is a printed page it had read as a plate.
